hypothesis: After a V15 lower-band interaction, a counter-trend pullback followed by re-break of the pullback low should create a same-auction short with invalidation above the pullback high.

prediction_before_outcome.preserve: one pullback/re-break episode per symbol, with cross-asset arbitration before outcome
prediction_before_outcome.remove: direct lower-band chases, setups without a counter-trend pullback, setups without re-break, and trigger/stop ambiguity
prediction_before_outcome.expected_effect: at least half a selected episode per day, positive cost-after one-R and two-R diagnostic expectancy, and median favorable excursion above costs
prediction_before_outcome.falsification: round-trip costs consume the structural R, or fixed one-R and two-R payoffs remain negative despite attractive gross excursion

fixed_geometry.entry: first later minute trading below the first bullish pullback candle low
fixed_geometry.invalidation: above the same pullback candle high

implementation_correction.reason: The initial R analysis did not convert the 20-bps cost floor into setup-specific R. Because pullback risk was often only 16-33 bps, fees and slippage consumed roughly 0.6-1.2 median R and sometimes more.

causal_interpretation.valid_clue: Pullback/re-break improved gross entry geometry relative to direct lower-band chasing and created frequent favorable excursion.
causal_interpretation.fatal_constraint: The structural stop is usually too narrow relative to realistic turnover cost, so favorable raw movement does not translate into cost-after R.
causal_interpretation.why_not_widen_stop: Widening the stop merely to improve cost/R would sever invalidation from the pullback auction and would be a numerical rescue, not the tested causal setup.
causal_interpretation.why_not_tune_windows: All three fixed windows had negative cost-after one-R and two-R diagnostics; changing wait windows would search for a backtest peak without fixing the economic geometry.

reason: The setup has adequate frequency and raw excursion but negative cost-after geometry in every fresh window. No Nautilus account, parameter sweep, or long validation is justified.
